# Baseline compliance report (authoritative)

**Status**: AUTHORITATIVE. Generated by the US1 checker
(`test/verifiedTests/documentation/checkHeaderCompliance.m` +
`checkFunctionHeaders.m` + `headerComplianceExclusions.m`) over the full `src/`
tree. This supersedes the preliminary heuristic snapshot (FR-002, SC-006). The
numbers below are the pre-remediation state that the per-leaf-folder work-units
must drive to zero **error**-severity in-scope violations.

**Generated from**: branch `014-src-header-compliance`, HEAD `7f4a27c6f`
(working tree). Rule catalog: `contracts/header-rules.md`. Scan time: ~7 s for
1578 files in a single MATLAB process (headless, no solver/internet/GUI).

## Scope

- Total `src/*.m` scanned: **1578**
- **In scope**: **1498** files (functions **1411**, scripts/classdef **87**)
- **Excluded (vendored / read-only)**: **80** files
  - `src/reconstruction/rBioNet/` — **40** files (vendored subtree)
  - `src/reconstruction/comparison/modelBorgifier/` — **39** files (vendored subtree)
  - `src/base/io/python/pyPath/py_addpath.m` — **1** file (licence guard:
    header carries a BSD "redistribution and use" notice)

The excluded set is fully specified by the two subtree globs plus the single
licence-guarded file above (79 + 1 = 80). `classdef` files are classified as
scripts (H-DESC + H-PCT only) to avoid misparsing method signatures.

### Counting convention

- Block-presence and line-format rules (H-EMPTY, H-DESC, H-PCT, H-USAGE,
  H-FIELD, H-BODYGAP, H-SIG, H-AUTHOR) emit at most **one** violation per file
  (with a count in the detail where several lines are affected).
- Per-argument / per-field rules (H-IN, H-OUT, H-ARGFMT, H-NV, H-FIELDUSE) emit
  **one** violation per offending argument or input, so their counts are totals
  across the tree rather than a file count.

### Precision-limited rules (deliberately under-reported to avoid false positives)

- **H-NV** (count 4): only the statically unambiguous `inputParser`
  `addParameter`/`addOptional`/`addRequired`/`addParamValue` names are checked.
  Other `varargin` idioms (`parseCobraVarargin`, `getCobraSolverParams`,
  `struct(varargin{:})` ad-hoc reads) are not flagged.
- **H-FIELDUSE**: only fields read as `name.field` (excluding `name.field(`
  method-style calls) on a **documented** input are flagged; dynamic field
  access is ignored.
- **H-USAGE**: presence of the block and of the call signature is checked; the
  blank-line placement around the keyword is left to the Sphinx oracle.
- **H-FIELD**: the clearly-wrong `*.field` (missing space after `*`) form is
  flagged; sub-bullet indent alignment is not.

## How this was regenerated

```matlab
% from the repo root, in MATLAB (no initCobraToolbox required)
addpath('test/verifiedTests/documentation');
report = checkHeaderCompliance('src', 1);   % printLevel 1 = per-domain summary
```

`report.totals`, `report.perDomain`, `report.perRule`, `report.excluded`, and
`report.violations` carry the machine-readable form of every number above.
Re-running on the same tree yields the identical report (deterministic text
analysis). The CI gate is `runtests('test/verifiedTests/documentation/testHeaderCompliance.m')`,
which is also discovered automatically by `test/testAll.m`.
